_doc: One host admission gate for agents, lanes, typechecks, test suites and git hooks. Read by scripts/hostops/host_admit.py (CLI `host-admit`, lane_runner, preflight, .husky/pre-push). Sized for Gem (16 cores, 62 GiB). maxLoadPerCore compares the 1-minute load average to the core count. Processes started outside the gate still count through `processes` matchers, so agents launched before the gate existed are not invisible.

build._doc: Execution host (Gem). Every class is admitted when capacity allows.

orchestrator._doc: Tim's Mac runs orchestration and sessions only; execution classes are refused and belong on Gem or hosted CI.

hook-light._doc: macOS load averages count blocked I/O threads and read far above Linux for the same work; gate Mac hooks on concurrency and memory only.

agent._doc: Headless coding agents (codex exec, claude -p). Replaces artdir slot.sh (<4 codex exec, >=8 GB).

lane._doc: lane_runner workers. Each worker leases its own pid; provider slot caps in lane_runner still apply on top.

typecheck._doc: tsc runs (3-4.5 GB RSS each). Replaces the ~/.cache/gem-typecheck.lock flock.

test-suite._doc: Full or affected test suites (lane gate seats, qualification pushes).

hook-light._doc: Fast, targeted git-hook checks. Waits briefly and never queues behind full suites: heavy classes defer well before this ceiling.
